description: Find current products by lender and words in the product name, e.g. institution "CBA" and query "standard variable". Returns institution_id and product_id for each match, with category, rate and observed_date. A product is the pair (institution_id, product_id): pass both to rate_history or rate_details. Use compare_rates instead to rank lenders for a category.

institution.description: A lender id or name, e.g. "cba", "Westpac", "Bendigo Bank".

query.description: Words in the product name, e.g. "standard variable" or "bonus saver".

name: find_products
